name: Infrastructure & Connectivity
short: Roads, bridges and regional links that connect farms to markets and states to each other.
description: The Commission plans and delivers critical infrastructure across the region — rural feeder roads, bridges, and regional trade corridors — prioritising the routes that unlock agricultural markets and reconnect communities cut off by insecurity or flooding.

name: Agriculture & Food Security
short: Making the region's farming potential the engine of national food security.
description: The North Central zone is Nigeria's food basket. The Commission supports agro-industrial clusters, incubation centres, irrigation and value-chain infrastructure so the region's produce feeds the nation and creates jobs at home.

name: Peace, Security & Rehabilitation
short: Resettling displaced communities and rebuilding what conflict destroyed.
description: A core statutory mandate: the resettlement, rehabilitation, reintegration and reconstruction of roads, houses and business premises for communities affected by banditry, farmer-herder conflict and other insecurity — working with traditional rulers, community leaders and security agencies on peacebuilding and conflict prevention.
programmes: Logistical and strategic support to security agencies

name: Health
short: Strengthening primary healthcare where communities need it most.
description: The Commission invests in primary healthcare centres, medical outreach and health-system strengthening across underserved LGAs, coordinating with state ministries and development partners.

name: Education & Human Capital
short: Classrooms, skills and scholarships for the region's young majority.
description: From rebuilding classrooms to digital skills and scholarship programmes, the Commission develops the human capital of a region where most citizens are under 30.

name: Solid Minerals Development
short: Responsible mining that benefits host communities.
description: The zone holds some of Nigeria's richest mineral belts — lithium, tin, barite, iron ore, coal. The Commission works with the Federal Ministry of Solid Minerals and state governments to develop community-based mining cooperatives, promote responsible practices and keep value in the region. The Act also mandates NCDC to assess and report on projects run by mining and other companies operating in the zone.
programmes: Responsible-mining partnerships with FMSD and states

name: Ecology & Erosion Control
short: Confronting flooding, erosion and environmental degradation.
description: Tackling the ecological challenges named in the Commission's founding Act — gully erosion, seasonal flooding along the Niger-Benue system, deforestation and land degradation.
programmes: Flood-resilience works along the Niger–Benue valleys

name: Youth, Women & Innovation
short: Empowerment, digital skills and inclusion for the region's future.
description: Empowerment programmes targeting youths, women and persons with disabilities, plus a planned regional innovation hub promoting creativity, digital skills and job creation.
programmes: Regional innovation hub (digital skills & job creation)
